source.note: Kenney cone (the standing striped one; the kit's cone-flat is a squat knocked-down puck). FBX like car-suv and car-sedan from the same kit and pin; the plan named the GLB member, which references Textures/colormap.png. Kit scale: the cone is 0.595 units tall and the sedan 1.3 units, which became 1.45 m, so the cone gets 0.66 m (a standard 28-inch road cone is 0.71 m); its square base is 0.53 m wide, wider than a real cone's (~0.36 m) in the kit's toy proportions. Kenney's orange tip, base and grey-white band are recoloured to the indigo script's amber-orange iris with the accent red as its shade (the same pair as car-suv; the red shade stays clear of the ink outline) and the band to paper white with moonlight blue as its shade. Static, no clips.
